meta.title: Give Feedback on the awarding page

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS.
Enter the awarding page where Give Feedback is available.

args.goal: On the awarding page, click Give Feedback, select a rating, enter QA as the feedback, send it, and verify the thank-you confirmation; then reopen Give Feedback, leave the feedback empty, submit it, and stop with the refusal message “Please share your feedback” visible.

steps.note: Perform and observe both the successful feedback submission and the required empty-feedback refusal.
Assert that the empty feedback submission is refused with the specified message.
